detail.longDescription: 🤖 Supply-chain attack on GitHub Actions: compromised maintainer accounts (incl. pyxel's author) pushed credential-stealing workflows into 340+ repositories, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets from runners. 🔗 https:// thehackernews.com/2026/10/cred ential-stealing-github-actions.html # SupplyChain # CyberSec # InfoSec # GitHub
